summary: Ferrari N.V. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing daily repurchases under its Third Tranche buyback, part of a roughly Euro 3.5 billion multi-year program announced at the 2025 Capital Markets Day. From September 21-25, 2026, it bought 82,524 common shares for about Euro 29.8 million, average Euro 361.06, and has invested Euro 57.46 million in the tranche. Treasury stood at 1,805,393 shares, or 1.02%. Watch execution pace and treasury overhang.
